chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 05 (Unit 16: Chemical Industries & Metallurgy)
subject: chemistry-10

questions.question: In the Solvay process, which two chemicals are dissolved in water to produce ammoniacal brine?
questions.explanation: Ammonia ($NH_3$) and common salt ($NaCl$) dissolve in water to produce ammoniacal brine.

questions.question: In the froth flotation process, sulphide ore particles are preferentially wetted by:
questions.explanation: Pine oil wets sulphide ore particles and floats them to the surface with air bubbles, while gangue is wetted by water and sinks.

questions.question: What is the percentage of nitrogen by mass in pure urea fertilizer ($NH_2CONH_2$)?
questions.explanation: Urea ($NH_2CONH_2$) contains two nitrogen atoms in a molar mass of 60 g/mol: $(28/60) \times 100 = 46.6\%$.

questions.question: What intermediate chemical compound is formed when liquid ammonia reacts with carbon dioxide under pressure in urea manufacture?
questions.explanation: $2NH_3 + CO_2 \rightleftharpoons NH_2COONH_4$ (ammonium carbamate) at 200°C and 200 atm.

questions.question: In copper metallurgy, the molten mixture of $Cu_2S$ and $FeS$ obtained from the blast furnace is called:
questions.explanation: Smelting roasted copper pyrites in a blast furnace produces molten copper matte ($Cu_2S + FeS$, ~45% Cu).

questions.question: What is the approximate purity of blister copper obtained from the Bessemer converter?
questions.explanation: Blister copper is ~98% pure; escaping $SO_2$ gas forms characteristic blisters on its surface upon solidification.

questions.question: During the electrolytic refining of copper, the cathode is made of:

options.B: A thin sheet of high-purity copper (99.99%)

questions.explanation: Pure copper deposits onto the cathode sheet ($Cu^{2+} + 2e^- \to Cu$), yielding 99.99% refined copper.

questions.question: Which unrecoverable chemical byproduct is generated in the ammonia recovery tower of Solvay's process?
questions.explanation: $2NH_4Cl + Ca(OH)_2 \to 2NH_3\uparrow + CaCl_2 + 2H_2O$. $CaCl_2$ is the sole unrecyclable byproduct.

questions.question: What reaction takes place in the calcination step of Solvay's process to yield soda ash ($Na_2CO_3$)?
questions.explanation: Heating dry sodium bicarbonate decomposes it into soda ash ($Na_2CO_3$), steam, and $CO_2$ (which is recycled).

questions.question: Which petroleum refining fraction contains $C_7-C_{10}$ hydrocarbons, boils between 40°C and 200°C, and powers automobile engines?
questions.explanation: Gasoline ($C_7-C_{10}$) boils between 40°C and 200°C, serving as motor fuel.

questions.question: What is the chemical formula of copper pyrites (chalcopyrite)?
questions.explanation: Copper pyrites has the formula $CuFeS_2$, the principal commercial ore of copper.

questions.question: What is the residue collected at the very base of a crude petroleum fractionating tower ($C_{30}+$, boiling $>400^\circ\text{C}$)?
questions.explanation: Asphalt (bitumen) comprises heavy residue hydrocarbons used for road surfacing and roofing.
